translations.web: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
translations.bsb: for which I suffer to the extent of being chained like a criminal. But the word of God cannot be chained!
translations.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is ➔ not bound.
translations.asv: wherein I suffer hardship unto bonds, as a malefactor; but the word of God is not bound.
